subject: ggplot2: legend justification changes to right when using italics - why? and how can I avoid this?

messages.author: 1382389258fcbbc7
messages.subject: ggplot2: legend justification changes to right when using italics - why? and how can I avoid this?
parts:
Hi,

I have a legend where some text needs to be in italics. This is no problem, but the justification changes when I add the italics. Why is this and how can I change it to be justified to the left side?
Here is some ugly dummy data and an ugly graph. I am really bad in creating good dummy data. However, this script looks great for my original data. It illustrates my problem however. I also have problems writing parts of the ylab in italics. If a non-italic word is before the italics part - nothing is written:  ylab(expression("the", italic("y-axis italics"), "stuff"))+ #why is this not working?
Thank you all for your time and patience! The ggplot2 group will definitely be in my thesis acknowledgements! :-)
best
Anna

mydata<- data.frame(factor1 = factor(rep(LETTERS[1:3], each = 160)), #Dummy data
                    factor2 = factor(rep(c(1:2), each = 16)),
                    factor3 = factor(rep(c(3:5), each = 32)),
                    var1 = rnorm(120, mean = rep(c(0, 3, 15), each = 40),
                                 sd = rep(c(1, 3, 6), each = 20)),
                    var2 = rnorm(120, mean = rep(c(14, 35, 2), each = 40),
                                 sd = rep(c(6, 1, 0.3), each = 20)))

p <- ggplot(data = mydata,aes(x = var1,y = var2)) + 
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("This is extremely ugly and unclear, but please ignore this as my question is
          regarding the legend justification only. I am bad at creating good dummy data. Sorry.")+
  ylab(expression("the", italic("y-axis italics"), "stuff"))+ #why is this not working?
  xlab("the x-axis stuff")+
  geom_point(mapping=aes(shape=factor2, col=factor3), size=3.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, colour="black", family="serif", angle=90))
p + scale_colour_discrete(name  ="my factor 3",
                          breaks=c("3", "4", "5"),
                          labels=c("factor 3-3", "factor 3-4", "factor 3-5")) +
  scale_shape_discrete(name  ="my factor 2",
                       breaks=c("1", "2"),
                       labels=expression(italic("italics factor 2-1"), 
                                         "factor 2-2"))+
  theme(legend.key = element_blank())

If you don't like the legend label alignment you can change it;

theme(legend.key = element_blank(), legend.text.align = 0)

see ?theme for the list of things you can change.

Best,
Ista
